primitives.name: Dynamic Time-to-Game Freshness Gate
primitives.verbatim_quote: The honest version needs no new stack: compute line-movement velocity from our own successive odds fetches and fire a workflow_dispatch when it spikes.
primitives.assumptions: Line movement velocity is a proxy for market volatility; refreshes are triggered only when velocity exceeds a learned threshold.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \(\frac{dO}{dt} < \theta_{\text{spike}}\), no refresh occurs; otherwise, a workflow dispatch is initiated.

layer2.mapping: Operates within the data loop to ensure real-time responsiveness to market dynamics.
layer2.telemetry: Velocity of odds changes over time

primitives.name: Closed Loop Data Validation
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Data loop**: fetch → per-game freshness gate (time-aware) → publish or refuse → the refusal itself is diagnosed in the error → failure pings the owner's phone → the fix feeds back into the gate.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\mathcal{L}_{\\text{data}}': 'data ingestion process (unitless)', '\\mathcal{F}': 'freshness condition (dimensionless)', '\\mathcal{G}': 'gate function (unitless)', '\\mathcal{P}': 'publish action (boolean)', '\\mathcal{R}': 'reject action (boolean)'}
primitives.assumptions: Validation errors are diagnosable and actionable; feedback loops correct gate behavior.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If \(\mathcal{G}(\mathcal{F}) = \text{false}\), then \(\mathcal{R}\) is executed and alert is sent.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI’s model calibration loop through shared diagnostic and feedback mechanisms.
layer2.telemetry: Gate rejection rate and error diagnosis frequency

primitives.name: Model Calibration Feedback Loop
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Model loop**: picks settle → calibration table updates → the held-out validator (ready to run, 167 eligible picks) grades whether the calibrator beats raw confidence → PASS unlocks the audited activation → new MODEL_VERSION, never retroactive.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\mathcal{M}_{\\text{new}}': 'new model version (unitless)', '\\mathcal{C}': 'calibration function (unitless)', '\\mathcal{P}_{\\text{held-out}}': 'held-out picks (count)', '\\mathcal{V}': 'validator function (unitless)', '\\mathcal{V}_{\\text{baseline}}': 'baseline validation score (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Model improvements must be validated on unseen data before activation; retroactivity is prohibited.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If validation score exceeds baseline, new model version is activated; else, no change.

layer2.mapping: Mirrors the data loop’s feedback structure but applies to model performance and confidence adjustments.
layer2.telemetry: Model version activation rate and held-out validation scores

The dynamic freshness gate leverages real-time odds velocity to trigger refreshes, avoiding speculative AI models. This aligns with the data loop's structure where failures are diagnosed and corrected via alerts. The model loop ensures that improvements are validated before deployment, preventing retroactive changes. The system avoids overfitting by enforcing monotonicity in freshness tuning and prohibiting retroactive model updates. The interplay between these loops creates a resilient architecture where truth and money are safeguarded by explicit gatekeepers.
